overall_assessment: Extraction is mostly accurate for MF: course_content, coursework_requirements, assessment and learning_outcomes are cleanly cut and complete. The main defects are that reading_list is always generic library-access boilerplate (no actual literature), and that two inline sections (Arbeidsform, Forkunnskapskrav) are absorbed into neighbouring sections.

findings.evidence: Noe av litteraturen er digital, annet finnes kun i papirutgave. Kompendier kan være tilgjengelige i Canvas.
findings.description: In every course with a Litteraturliste heading, reading_list holds only the identical 597-char (609 for one variant) library-access boilerplate ("Litteraturlisten for" followed by 'Tilgang til litteratur'). The plans contain no actual literature entries (the real list is evidently not in the harvested text), so the section is boilerplate rather than a reading list. The 'boilerplate' flag is a true positive, and it is institution-wide (all 15 courses with the heading).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The MF Litteraturliste block is rendered dynamically/separately (title is truncated to 'Litteraturlisten for' and the list is missing), so the fulltext extraction only contains the static access note; the sections extractor then maps the heading to reading_list verbatim.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() for mf, strip the 'Litteraturlisten for ...' line and the 'Tilgang til litteratur' paragraph and drop reading_list when nothing remains (or emit NA). Separately fix the MF fulltext selector/harvest to capture the actual literature list.

findings.evidence:
Arbeidsform og organisering

Emnet organiseres i 6 moduler som alle må gjennomføres for å ta eksamen. Hver modul består av:
findings.description: Under 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' the plan has an embedded sub-heading 'Arbeidsform og organisering' (teaching methods: modules, lectures, seminars). The splitter did not cut at it, so it sits inside coursework_requirements and no teaching_methods row is emitted. This is the 'leak->teaching_methods' flag, which is real. Other MF courses where 'Arbeidsform og organisering:' is a separate block (PRA1005, PRA1004, SAM1000L) are extracted correctly, so the problem is the heading being nested inside the obligatoriske aktiviteter block.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Splitter cuts only at top-level headings (Om studiet / Obligatoriske aktiviteter / Avsluttende vurdering / Læringsutbytte); the sub-heading 'Arbeidsform og organisering' within the coursework block is not treated as a boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure 'Arbeidsform og organisering' (with or without trailing colon) is a boundary at any position in the mf plan, cutting it out of coursework_requirements into teaching_methods.

findings.description: An inline 'Forkunnskapskrav: ...' line at the end of the introductory text is kept at the tail of course_content instead of being extracted as prerequisites. No prerequisites row is emitted for these courses, although the prerequisite is explicit. Contrast SAM2080L and SAM1050, where a 'Forkunnskaper' heading correctly yields prerequisites. The 'leak->prerequisites' flags are real.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The prerequisites pattern in R/section_heading_map.R only matches 'Forkunnskaper' as a standalone heading line, not the 'Forkunnskapskrav:' label with inline text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line-start pattern for '^Forkunnskapskrav\b:?' in R/section_heading_map.R mapped to prerequisites, splitting the remainder of the line off as section text.

findings.evidence: Undervisningen er delt inn i forelesninger og veiledning. Begge deler er obligatorisk.
findings.description: Teaching-format statements embedded in the unheaded introduction stay in course_content with no teaching_methods row. Minor, since the plan has no heading for them.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No heading in the source, so heading-based splitting cannot separate them.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept as a limitation, or optionally add a paragraph-level rule for paragraphs starting 'Undervisningen er/består'.
